title: Nhận định Argentina vs Algeria — World Cup 2026

scenes.subjectHint: Hook split-frame — Messi (Argentina) vs Mahrez (Algeria), cúp World Cup ở giữa
scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16 split-frame football poster artwork showing a 2026 FIFA World Cup group-stage showdown. Left half: Lionel Messi, the Argentine forward and captain for the Argentina national team, in a sky-blue-and-white striped Argentina home kit with the AFA crest and three champion stars clearly visible on the chest, intense focused hero pose. Behind him, a stylized sky-blue Argentina graphic backdrop with a huge faint AFA crest watermark and radiating golden light rays. Right half: Riyad Mahrez, the Algerian winger and captain for the Algeria national team, in a white Algeria home kit with green trim and the Algerian Football Federation crest clearly visible on the chest, mirroring determined hero pose. Behind him, a stylized white-and-green Algeria graphic backdrop with a huge faint crest watermark and radiating light rays. Down the centre seam: a diagonal lightning-burst slash separator with dramatic energy glow, the golden FIFA World Cup trophy glowing as a stylized graphic accent between them. Vibrant saturated palette per side, very high contrast, glossy graphic-design finish. Stylized like a World Cup matchday rivalry promotional poster. Both crests visible on the jerseys, no on-image text or captions, no scoreboard graphics.
